h1: New-build apartment handover inspection in Bratislava

blocks.text: New-build apartment handover inspection in Bratislava

parts.html: A handover inspection of a new-build apartment is an important step before moving in that helps you avoid hidden defects and unnecessary repair costs. DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers professional assistance with property handover in Bratislava to ensure your new home meets the promised quality standards.
✔️ Checking that the apartment complies with the project documentation
✔️ Inspecting wall, ceiling, and floor finishes for defects
✔️ Checking windows, doors, and balcony structures
✔️ Testing utility systems (electrical, water supply, ventilation)
✔️ Assessing the quality of plumbing fixtures and installed equipment
✔️ Checking walls for angular deviations and floors for levelness
✔️ Documenting identified defects and drawing up a list of issues for the developer
✔️ Advice on next steps if defects are found
📌 €250 – handover inspection of an apartment up to 50 m²
📌 €400 – handover inspection of an apartment of 50 m² or more
📌 If you need a follow-up inspection after the developer has fixed the defects, a repeat visit costs €200.
✅ Experience in design and renovation — we know what to look for
✅ We work in the client’s interests, not the developer’s
✅ We help prepare formal defect notices for the developer
Book a professional apartment handover inspection with DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) and gain confidence in the quality of your new home!
